Local execution protection could not be established because recovery storage is unavailable or invalid, its safety limit was reached, or another RunId is already present. No execution or reconciliation was started. Keep this page open and contact an administrator.

Disabled, resigned, and suspended people stay on the people-and-roles sheet. Administrator permissions are on their own sheet.

Click Save to apply. Permissions inherited from other roles or direct user grants are unaffected.

englishOverrides.Account.permission.roleLoadFailed: Failed to load roles. Please try again.

englishOverrides.Account.permission.emptyPermissions: No configurable permissions for this role
englishOverrides.Account.permission.dependencyHint: Granting a child permission automatically grants its parent; revoking a parent revokes all its children.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.discardHint: Role “{role}” has {count} unsaved changes. Continuing will discard them.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.reviewHint: About to save {count} permission changes for role “{role}”. Please verify the scope; affected users must sign in again after saving.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.opsConfirmDescription: This change includes operations-level permissions that are typically unnecessary for business roles. Please confirm the intended scope and impact.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.opsAcknowledge: I have reviewed the operations permission scope and confirm granting it
englishOverrides.Account.permission.concurrentChangeHint: Saved permissions for this role were modified elsewhere. Your draft is preserved—close this preview, reload, and review again.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.compareSavedHint: Compares saved direct grants between the two roles; excludes inherited or per-user grants.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.compareUnsavedHint: The current role has unsaved edits; comparison below reflects saved permissions only. Save and reopen to view updated diffs.

englishOverrides.Account.permission.draftUnavailable: Browser draft storage is unavailable. Save your changes before switching tabs or leaving.
